Quantum-gas microscope resolves the 'color' of individual atoms in a single shot
stories.t: In 2024, researchers at the Ultracold Quantum Gases group at ICFO built a quantum-gas microscope capable of imaging individual atoms in strontium quantum gases for the first time, marking a key enabling step for quantum simulation.
